notes: Wrote three analyses from Broadcom VMSA-2026-0011, Broadcom KB463535, Rapid7, SOCRadar, ThaiCERT and HKCERT. None of the three is in CISA KEV, so no CISA entry exists to read. CVE-2026-123903: priority immediate, because Rapid7 reports a public PoC it validated for an unauthenticated network flaw; confidence medium because the sources disagree on the PoC and there is no root cause. ESX CVE-2026-123910/123911: priority urgent (critical, unauthenticated, no exploitation reported); confidence medium (vendor-only detail). No exploit code was opened.
